title: Red Line overview
content: The Red Line is one of the four MBTA rapid transit lines in Boston. It runs between Alewife in the north and Ashmont/Braintree in the south, splitting at JFK/UMass. Trains typically run every 4-9 minutes during peak hours and every 9-13 minutes off-peak. End-to-end travel from Alewife to Ashmont takes about 41 minutes; Alewife to Braintree takes about 37 minutes. The Red Line connects Cambridge, downtown Boston, Dorchester, and Quincy.

title: Green Line B Branch overview
content: The Green Line B Branch runs from Government Center to Boston College along Commonwealth Avenue, mostly above ground after Kenmore. Trains run every 7-9 minutes during peak hours. End-to-end takes about 49 minutes. The B Branch is the slowest of the Green Line branches due to many surface stops.

title: Green Line C Branch overview
content: The Green Line C Branch runs from Government Center to Cleveland Circle along Beacon Street. End-to-end takes about 38 minutes during off-peak and longer at peak. Headway is typically 8-10 minutes.

title: Green Line D Branch overview
content: The Green Line D Branch runs from Union Square to Riverside, mostly on the dedicated Highland Branch right-of-way. It is the fastest Green Line branch end-to-end (about 50 minutes Union Square to Riverside).

title: Green Line E Branch overview
content: The Green Line E Branch runs from Medford/Tufts to Heath Street via the Northeastern University area. Headway is about 9 minutes peak and 12 minutes off-peak. The E Branch shares track in the central subway with B, C, and D branches between Government Center and Copley.

title: Orange Line overview
content: The Orange Line connects Oak Grove in Malden to Forest Hills in Jamaica Plain via downtown Boston. End-to-end travel time is about 40 minutes. Trains typically run every 6-9 minutes peak and 10-12 minutes off-peak.

title: Blue Line overview
content: The Blue Line runs between Wonderland in Revere and Bowdoin in downtown Boston. End-to-end is about 24 minutes. Headway is about 4-6 minutes peak.

title: Silver Line SL1
content: The SL1 Silver Line bus rapid transit connects South Station to Logan Airport via the Ted Williams Tunnel. Travel time is roughly 18-25 minutes depending on traffic and which terminal you exit at.

title: Bus Route 8 (Harbor Point/UMass via JFK/UMass)
content: MBTA bus route 8 connects Harbor Point/UMass Boston with Kenmore via JFK/UMass. UMass Boston students often combine this bus with the Red Line at JFK/UMass station to reach the Boston University area. Headway is about 25-35 minutes off-peak and 15-20 minutes peak.
